dimensionDefinitions.label: Inventory boundary
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether the relevant corpus universe is scoped and enumerated without treating a run floor as exhaustive.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Provenance and locators
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether evidence can be traced to resolvable, exact and, where required, hash-bound locators.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Citation readiness
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether citation classifications and claim locators support the intended use.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Evidence appraisal
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether required sources have a current, reviewed structured appraisal or explicit reviewed exclusion.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Archive durability
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether required evidence has durable, accessible archive copies or verified local hashes where licensing permits.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Identity parity
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether source, database and artifact identities are reconciled on one declared lineage.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Queue workflow
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether research, appraisal and remediation queues have controlled routes and do not masquerade as completed evidence.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Freshness and vintage
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether audit time, source vintage and subject-matter period are explicit and mutually consistent.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Structural integrity
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether structural checks pass and are reproducible on the declared lineage.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Human review
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether required human, partner or rights-holder review is documented by immutable receipts.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Operational proof
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether required execution layers are distinguished and verified, including backup, runtime and interface behavior.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Conflict control
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether contradictory status, identity and evidence observations remain visible and receipt-bound when resolved.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Receipt integrity
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether required actions and decisions have immutable, resolvable receipts.

dimensionDefinitions.label: Source snapshot integrity
dimensionDefinitions.description: Whether every health claim is bound to immutable file, commit and database-query snapshots.

profileDefinitions.label: Internal discovery
profileDefinitions.purpose: Locate and inspect internal material with explicit caveats; this does not authorize external claims.

profileDefinitions.label: Internal analysis
profileDefinitions.purpose: Support reproducible internal analysis on one reconciled corpus and database lineage.

profileDefinitions.label: External evidence support
profileDefinitions.purpose: Support externally used claims with exact locators, appraisal, durable evidence, reconciled identity and required review.

profileDefinitions.label: Observatory operations
profileDefinitions.purpose: Operate a reproducible, monitored knowledge observatory with verified operational layers and immutable receipts.

failClosedRules.description: A code/database migration or seed-identity mismatch blocks reproducible analysis and observatory operation.
External evidence support requires complete current appraisal or explicit reviewed exclusion for the required evidence scope.
External evidence support requires durable archive coverage for the required scope.
A machine result cannot satisfy a required human, partner or rights-holder gate.
A source or query hash mismatch invalidates every dependent metric and verdict.
